name: Cabinet Thermistor Voltage
purpose: Verify NTC thermistor signal at main PCB connector — voltage falls as temperature drops.
failureModes: Stuck high (~4.5 V) or low (~0 V) = open/short or harness fault
Out of range vs cabinet temp = failed sensor or wrong connector pin
testingTips: Samsung SxS: CN20/CN40 pins per service manual §4-2 (typically 4.5 V warm → 1.0 V cold)
Compare multiple sensors if one code points to a specific LED (F-Sensor, R-Sensor, F-DEF-Sensor)
notes: Voltage-based check is often faster than kΩ table lookup on Samsung inverter platforms.

name: Evaporator Fan Feedback Voltage
purpose: Confirm BLDC evaporator fan feedback signal while fan is commanded on.
failureModes: No 7–12 V feedback with command present = motor, harness, or FG line fault
Intermittent feedback = ice drag, loose connector, or failing fan PCB
testingTips: Samsung F-FAN CN20 pins 15–17; C-FAN pins 22–24 — fan may stop with door open
Allow 1 min after door close at high ambient before calling F-fan failed

name: Inverter IPM DC Supply
purpose: Verify inverter has adequate DC bus for compressor start on variable-speed systems.
failureModes: Under 13.5 V DC = comp starting failure / IPM fault codes (84C, 86E)
Low voltage with good line supply = inverter board or harness CN70
testingTips: Read per manufacturer inverter LED blink pattern after 5-minute lockout
Check compressor terminal shorts U/V/W before replacing inverter

name: Samsung SxS Defrost Heater Resistance
purpose: Verify Samsung side-by-side defrost heater resistance at CN70/CN85.
failureModes: 0 Ω = heater short — power off immediately
∞ Ω = open heater or open defrost bimetal / thermal fuse
testingTips: Disconnect power; measure CN70 pin 5 to CN85 pin 3 per Samsung §4-2
Resistance varies slightly with input voltage — ±7% from 63 Ω nominal
